Drawn from each context's `class Context` in `_commands/<Context>/_<Context>.py` (`inherits`, `parents`, `occupiable`) and each command's `@descends_to`. No file declares the root: the root record is the one the workflow sets as `workflow.root` at run time, usually in its startup command.
